verdict: Brand24: Choose Brand24 when social listening, reputation monitoring, and mention analytics are the primary job — not scheduling or funnels. Scores use the marketing-editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Dedicated social listening across many source types
White-label / agency reporting on higher tiers
weaknesses: API may be an add-on below Enterprise
bestFor: PR and marketing teams monitoring brand and competitors
Agencies delivering monitoring reports to clients
notIdealFor: Users who only need to schedule social posts
Local review-generation workflows (use reputation tools instead)
tradeoffs: Specialist depth (listening vs scheduling vs funnels) vs all-in-one breadth
Published entry price vs contact/profile/mention upgrade pressure
Marketing automation / email depth vs pure ESP peers
recommendation: Choose Brand24 when social listening, reputation monitoring, and mention analytics are the primary job — not scheduling or funnels. Compare SocialBee for posting/scheduling, Meltwater/Brandwatch-class suites for enterprise listening, and NiceJob-class tools for review generation.
editorialNotes: Marketing Wave-2 batch. Approved on marketing-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. primaryCategorySlug=marketing. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Listening dashboards are approachable for PR/marketing teams; keyword/mention model needs onboarding but is standard for the category.
Not a content/scheduling product — low score by design versus SocialBee.
Monitoring/alerts are not marketing automation journeys — low by design.
No funnel/landing tooling — lowest conversion score among this wave.
Reach, awareness, sentiment, and reporting are first-party strengths for monitoring programs.
Core product job — social listening across 25M+ sources with sentiment and AI assistant; highest criterion score.
Slack/API/MCP documented; broader marketing-stack connectors are secondary to listening.
Mention/keyword ladders to Business/Enterprise support scale; caps are explicit.
Starts ~$199–$249/mo — premium vs schedulers; fair for listening specialists but pricey for light monitoring needs.
AI Brand Assistant and sentiment are marketed; not an AI content studio.

overallScoreRationale: Equal-weight average of 10 marketing-editorial criteria, rounded to 1 decimal. Not a hands-on lab score. Specialist tools score low on non-core criteria by design.
